intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both sit in {{cityA}}, and this page compares their recorded {{course}} fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in {{year}}.
GVP College of Engineering vs GITAM Visakhapatnam is not a single winner. GVP College of Engineering has a recorded NIRF 2021 #201, and GITAM Visakhapatnam has no NIRF rank on this page.

sections.heading: GVP College of Engineering vs GITAM Visakhapatnam for B.Tech: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose GVP College of Engineering if you want a recorded NIRF 2021 #201, and a 2021 flagship package record of ₹8 LPA, in a private B.Tech setting at Visakhapatnam.
Choose GITAM Visakhapatnam if you want a recorded fee of ₹2.22 lakh, in a private B.Tech setting at Visakhapatnam.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short, executive or certificate rows when the picker can tell them apart. Always match the fee to the exact programme you will join.
Our records show ₹1.09 lakh as a programme total for B.Tech Computer Science & Engineering at GVP College of Engineering.

Our records show ₹2.22 lakh as a tuition figure for B.Tech Computer Science & Engineering at GITAM Visakhapatnam. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: GVP College of Engineering's latest recorded flagship year here is 2021, with an average of ₹8 LPA and a highest package of ₹40 LPA on B.Tech Computer Science & Engineering. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.
We do not hold a 2020-or-later flagship placement year for GITAM Visakhapatnam here, so do not treat older or unofficial packages as current.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: GVP College of Engineering is listed on our records with AP EAPCET as an admission route for this B.Tech comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.
Our records do not list a confirmed entrance exam for GITAM Visakhapatnam on this page. Use the institute's current admission notice rather than last year's cut-off stories.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in {{cityA}}, Andhra Pradesh. If you want to stay in this city, the choice is less about relocation and more about the classroom, fees and the admission route.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read each official hostel and location note, before you treat travel time or hostel cost as a given.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you want a documented flagship placement year, GVP College of Engineering is the clearer record here, because GITAM Visakhapatnam has no 2020-or-later flagship package on this page.
Use official fee notices rather than our raw minimums, then decide whether GITAM Visakhapatnam's recorded ₹2.22 lakh or GVP College of Engineering's ₹1.09 lakh fits your budget for this B.Tech.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.
